top_catalysts.event: OPEC+ leaves November production requirements unchanged
top_catalysts.status: 已发生；按历史截止线重建
top_catalysts.what_happened: Seven participating OPEC+ countries said on October 4 that November required production would remain atSeptember levels. The statement has no verified intraday timestamp and is first used here on October 5.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The group has not announced a new target increase for November; the remaining uncertainty is actual production, exports and transport access.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: An unchanged quota does not fix damaged facilities or shipping constraints. Deliverable barrels, rather than nominal targets, determine the effective supply buffer.
top_catalysts.transmission: 目标不变→关注实际出口与可运输供应。 Brent December 2026 is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: Production and export measurements demonstrate that members can deliver the maintained targets.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Physical outages or transport restrictions cause deliveries to diverge from announced requirements.

top_catalysts.event: Houthi claims create an unquantified Saudi supply-risk test
top_catalysts.status: 报道确认；袭击后果未独立证实
top_catalysts.what_happened: Reuters reported during theOctober 5 Asian session that Yemen's Houthis claimed missile and drone attacks onSaudi Aramco sites. This reconstruction did not independently establish resulting output losses.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The newly reported claim adds a possible facility-risk channel to the existing conflict backdrop; it is not a verified loss-of-supply estimate.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: An actual outage could tighten oil and product supply; an unverified claim can move risk perception without changing delivered volumes. These mechanisms must remain separate.
top_catalysts.transmission: 设施/运输风险→油品供应与风险溢价。 Brent December 2026 is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: Operator or government statements confirm damage, duration and a measurable disruption to deliveries.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Operators establish that facilities and deliveries continue normally, weakening the physical-supply case.

top_catalysts.event: Scheduled services survey will test the growth and inflation mix
top_catalysts.what_happened: ISM announced that September services data would be released October 5 at 10:00EDT. The previously published headline was 55.4; actual September components were unknown at these earlier cutoffs.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The next scheduled evidence shifts attention from manufacturing and payrolls to services demand, input costs and employment.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: A services slowdown with cooling prices has different policy implications from a slowdown with rising costs; the component mix matters more than the headline alone.
top_catalysts.transmission: 服务需求/价格/就业→增长与加息权衡。 UST2Y is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: New orders, employment and prices together support a coherent growth or inflation interpretation.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Divergent component readings undermine a one-directional policy conclusion from the headline PMI.
